Chelsea held to draw by Hull City in Premier League match

Chelsea was held to a 2-2 draw by Hull City in a Premier League match at Stamford Bridge. Hull City's Joao Pedro scored a late equalizer to secure the point for his team. Morgan Rogers was highlighted for his performance, with one report noting he matched Chelsea greats. Sergej Jakirovic named a surprise Chelsea star as 'player of the match'. The match saw Chelsea unable to secure a victory at home.
